basic_info.description: Located on one of Noe Valley's most desirable blocks, this exceptional top-floor condo offers partial downtown views and the perfect opportunity to enjoy city living in a two-unit HOA converted to condos in 2013. This unique floor plan includes a spacious living room with views, modern gas fireplace, formal dining room, remodeled kitchen, two bedrooms (one w/views!), and a split bathroom. The space is filled with appealing period details such as multiple bay windows, hardwood floors, high coved ceilings, and historic accents. The kitchen features high end appliances, a laundry area with a s/s washer/dryer, and direct access to a large exclusive deck/yard area with storage shed perfect for entertaining and enjoying outdoor living.  A private detached art studio/office room is accessible via an intimate, lush walkway. Solar roof modules installed to both units and AC units serve the LR and BR. A tankless water heater system in garage. Also included is an independent one-car garage that offers additional storage space.   You'll find yourself conveniently located steps away from the shops, cafes, restaurants on 24th and Church Streets, Muni, Tech Shuttles stops, Dolores Park, Farmer's Market and the Valencia corridor, Market and the Valencia corridor, with easy freeway access.
